name: run_frame_state_dispatch
description: Runs one frame of a state machine: when the state word is nonzero it dispatches on the values 2, 4 and 5 to three handler paths, and otherwise adds two readings to a per-record position, clamps it against 27000 and redraws the record. When the state word is zero it integrates a velocity pair with a constant decrement of 21000 per frame and clamps the vertical term at zero.

name: run_frame_state_dispatch_flagged
description: Runs the same state machine as the frame routine with a non-zero state word, but first calls a helper with argument 3 and a no-argument helper when a flag byte is set. Its dispatch on values 2, 4 and 5 and its position update and clamp against 27000 match the frame routine.

name: run_idle_motion_and_timer
description: Loops while the state word is zero, integrating the velocity pair with a constant -21000 step and clamping one accumulator at zero. It then advances an animation byte from a table and, while a counter is active, steps a column value through a fixed range, drawing markers each step and treating one column as a special case.

name: dispatch_event_code_then_frame
description: Switches on an incoming event code: codes 9 and 11 set counters and a flag, code 16 clears the state word, codes 17 and 18 run a dialog check that sets a flag or triggers a helper, and code 26 clears the loop-exit flag. It then runs the same state dispatch loop as the frame routine.

name: step_state_dispatch_once
description: Performs a single pass of the state dispatch without looping: values 2, 4 and 5 call their handlers, and any other nonzero value redraws the current record after adding two readings to its position and clamping it against 27000.

name: update_record_position_clamped
description: Adds a sum and a difference of two input readings to the current record's position fields, calls a draw helper at the record index, and reverts that step when any of the three stored values exceeds 27000.

name: store_clamped_state_value
description: Calls a value source, stores its result in a state word clamped to the range 0 to 3, calls a helper on the state block, runs the shared update routine, and redraws the record when a flag is zero.

name: cap_state_value_at_three
description: Caps a state word at 3 when it exceeds that value, calls a helper, runs the shared update routine, and redraws the record when a flag is zero.

name: run_optional_redraw_then_helper
description: Redraws the record only when a flag is zero, then calls a helper on the state block.

name: copy_seed_pair_into_entry
description: Redraws the record and runs a helper with argument 7, copies two stored seed words into the current entry of a table, calls a helper with argument 300 and then redraws the record.

name: dispatch_state_code_once
description: Performs one pass of the state dispatch selected by an event code argument: codes 2, 4 and 5 call their handlers, and any other code redraws the current record after adding two readings to its position and clamping it against 27000.

name: return_without_work
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

name: run_indexed_helper_sequence
description: When a counter exceeds 9, sets a fixed value in one record field, marks a flag, stores 64 minus a value-source reading in a second field, refreshes the record, calls a helper for indices 1 to 4 with argument 5 after each call, and finishes with a helper call with argument 7.

name: resolve_terrain_collision_step
description: Looks up the code at the current grid position. Codes in a fixed set set a flag, while other codes trigger a bounce by reversing and damping the velocity terms or by returning a status from a scan of neighbouring cells. When the position is out of range it reloads the velocity terms from a value source and reports whether they stay within bounds.

name: set_state_flag_and_return
description: Sets a byte flag in the state block to 1 and returns zero.

name: apply_terrain_bounce_response
description: Classifies the terrain status of the current step and applies a bounce: a small status restarts the velocity terms from a value-source angle, while a larger status reverses and halves the velocities once when a flag is zero.

name: reverse_and_damp_velocity
description: When a flag is zero, negates one velocity term, halves the other two, stores 64 minus a value-source reading in a field, refreshes a record and sets the flag.

name: flag_or_bounce_by_code
description: Sets a flag when the event code is one of a fixed set of values; for any other code it applies the bounce response and returns zero.

name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns the value zero without doing any work.

name: classify_terrain_at_position
description: Returns a status code for the current grid position: 3 when the coordinates are out of range, 5 when the cell matches a stored target, 2 or 4 for special cells, and 1 when a cell code triggers a flag and a helper call. Otherwise it reloads the velocity terms from a value source and returns 1 or 0 depending on whether they stay within bounds.

name: classify_cell_then_reload
description: Returns 5 when the cell matches a stored target, otherwise looks up the cell code and returns 2, 4 or 1 for special codes after setting a flag and a helper call. When no special code applies it reloads the velocity terms from a value source and returns 1 or 0 depending on whether they stay within bounds.

name: classify_lookup_then_reload
description: Looks up the cell code at the current position and maps it to a status of 2, 4 or 1 for special codes, with a flag set and a helper call for one case. Otherwise it reloads the velocity terms from a value source and returns 1 or 0 depending on whether they stay within bounds.

name: set_flag_and_return_one
description: Sets a byte flag in the state block, calls a helper with argument 7 and returns one. The code is only reached by falling through from the preceding routine, so it is a fragment rather than an independent entry.

name: reload_velocity_within_bounds
description: Reloads the velocity terms from a value source, optionally applies a secondary adjustment, sets a flag and returns 1 when the velocity terms stay within the bounds of 65527, and returns 0 otherwise.

name: classify_event_code_then_reload
description: Maps the incoming event code to a status: 2 and 26 return 2, codes 3 and 6 set a flag and return 1 after a helper call, and code 5 scans forward along the column for a non-5 cell to return 4. Otherwise it reloads the velocity terms from a value source and returns 1 or 0 depending on whether they stay within bounds.

name: reload_velocity_terms_checked
description: Reloads the velocity terms from a value source, optionally applies a secondary adjustment, sets a flag and returns 1 when the terms stay within the bounds of 65527, and returns 0 otherwise.

name: return_zero_status
description: Does no work and returns zero.

name: copy_longword_block
description: Copies longwords from a source buffer to a destination, reducing a byte count by four per step until the count reaches zero or drops to three or less. It returns the data register value unchanged.

name: clear_longword_buffer
description: Zeroes 800 consecutive longwords starting at a buffer pointer kept in the state block.

name: draw_region_at_offset
description: Computes a draw position by offsetting the current position fields by fixed amounts, stores a value scaled by 5 from its argument, and calls a graphics helper with a 225-wide region and parameters 5, 8, 16 and 192.

name: draw_region_at_stored_position
description: Calls a graphics helper with a 225-wide region and parameters 5, 8, 16 and 192, using the position values stored in the state block.

name: plot_packed_bitmap_rows
description: Selects a 16-row bitmap from a table by index and, for each row, plots every set bit as a point offset by the stored position, then calls a finishing helper.

name: initialize_position_and_draw
description: Stores the start coordinates 111 and 188 with a second value of 188, sets a flag, draws two bitmap regions from the same position and calls a clear and a fixed-rectangle helper.

name: step_and_draw_object_sprite
description: Moves the object's position by the difference to the input point and by a value-source step, resets the position to the input when it leaves the expected range, then draws its sprite and shadow regions clipped to fixed bounds and redraws the pieces that move with it.

name: clamp_value_plus_minus_ten
description: Clamps a 16-bit value in place to the range from minus 10 to 10.

name: seed_start_position
description: Sets a starting position by adding two scaled value-source readings to base offsets, copies a stored frame value into the timer field, and seeds a third coordinate from another value-source reading.

name: call_helper_if_nonzero
description: Calls a value source and, when the result is nonzero, passes the two arguments and that result to a helper and returns the helper's value; otherwise it returns zero.

name: find_table_entry_by_name
description: Scans an eight-byte-stride table with the string comparison helper for a matching name; when the table is exhausted it sets an error code of 6 and returns zero. On a match it stores a result byte and a flag in the record and returns the record pointer.

name: clear_large_longword_region
description: Zeroes 10915 consecutive longwords starting at a computed offset into the state block, then stores a stack address and a global value into fields of that block and calls a setup routine.

name: compare_two_byte_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated byte strings character by character for at most about 32767 characters. It returns minus one if the first string is smaller at the first difference, one if it is larger, and zero when they match up to the terminator or the limit.

name: forward_with_constant_mode
description: Passes its two arguments on to a shared routine together with the constant 769 as the mode argument, and returns nothing.

name: allocate_handle_slot
description: Searches a table of twenty slots for a free entry and returns minus one with error code 8 when none is free. Otherwise it records the handle and its mode flags in the slot, optionally closing an existing handle first when the flags request it, and returns the slot index.

name: apply_result_sign_fixup
description: Calls an arithmetic helper and negates its result when exactly one of the two operand signs held in the data registers is negative.

name: return_second_arithmetic_result
description: Calls an arithmetic helper and returns the value it leaves in the second data register.

name: perform_32_bit_division
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor and returns the quotient and remainder together in a 64-bit value. It uses a direct 16-bit division when the divisor's high word is zero and a bit-by-bit shift-and-subtract loop otherwise.

name: emit_bytes_until_failure
description: Passes each byte of a buffer to a single-character helper, up to a count obtained from another helper call. It returns the third argument when every byte is accepted and zero as soon as the helper reports failure.

name: put_char_into_buffer
description: Appends one byte to a bounded buffer, advancing its write pointer, and returns the byte. When the buffer is full it hands the byte to an overflow routine instead.

name: initialize_stream_table
description: Walks the stream table in 22-byte records from the start to the end of the table and calls a per-record helper on each record.

name: close_stream_record
description: Flushes a stream record that has pending output, calls the close helper when the record is open, releases its buffer through a helper and clears its fields. It returns minus one for a missing record and otherwise the combined helper results.

name: write_byte_to_stream
description: Writes one byte into a stream record's buffer, flushing through a helper when the buffer is full or the record is unbuffered. It marks the record as failed and returns minus one when the record is in an error state or a write fails, and otherwise returns the byte.

name: allocate_free_stream_record
description: Searches the stream table for a record not in use, clears its fields and returns its address, or zero when every record is in use.

name: allocate_stream_buffer
description: Tries to allocate a 1024-byte buffer for a stream record and records it with a buffered flag. When that allocation fails, the record falls back to a one-byte unbuffered buffer.

name: free_all_list_nodes
description: Walks a singly linked list from the head stored in the state block, releases each node through a helper using its stored size plus an eight-byte header, and clears the head.

name: free_list_nodes_from_register
description: Releases every node of a singly linked list starting at the pointer held in an address register, passing each node and its size plus an eight-byte header to a helper, then clears the list head in the state block.

name: allocate_list_node_at_head
description: Allocates a block of the requested size plus an eight-byte header through a helper, links it at the head of the list and returns the address just past the header, or zero when allocation fails.

name: forward_single_argument_call
description: Passes its single argument on to a helper call and returns nothing.

name: remove_list_node_and_free
description: Searches the list for the node whose data address matches the argument, unlinks it, releases it through a helper with its size and an eight-byte header, and returns zero. It returns minus one when no node matches.

name: test_stream_record_open
description: Looks up the stream record for an index in the stream table through a library call and returns true when the record pointer is non-null.

name: set_error_on_failure
description: Calls a helper with its argument; on success it returns zero, and on failure it stores the helper's error value in the state block and returns minus one.

name: write_stream_checked
description: Validates a stream index against the twenty-entry table, checks that the record exists and has an access mode set, then forwards the call to a helper. Failures store an error code in the state block and return minus one.

name: check_signal_bit_then_helper
description: Tests bit 4096 of a value returned by a helper; when it is set and a state counter is nonzero, it calls two helpers and returns the result of the second, and otherwise it returns zero.

name: check_word_mismatch_then_forward
description: Compares a stored word with a value derived from the low word of a data register using fixed bit operations. On a mismatch it calls an error handler, then forwards the stacked argument to a helper.

name: start_and_parse_command_line
description: Opens the required library at version 31, then splits the command line into an argument array using a character class table, and calls the entry routine with that argument count and vector. Failures store an error code and return early.

name: shutdown_and_release_resources
description: Clears ten table slots through a helper, calls a stored callback, releases any non-null stored handles and buffers, and returns its argument.

name: release_handles_and_return
description: Clears ten table slots through a helper, calls a stored callback, releases any non-null stored handles and buffers, and returns its argument.

name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends a zero-terminated byte string to the end of a destination string, copying at most about 32767 characters and terminating the result. Returns the destination pointer.

name: append_string_with_count
description: Appends up to a given number of characters from a source string to the end of a destination string, terminates the result and returns the destination pointer.

name: copy_string_to_destination
description: Copies a zero-terminated byte string, including its terminator, into a destination buffer with no length limit, and returns the destination pointer.

name: copy_string_with_padding
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination buffer up to a given count or until a null terminator is reached, then fills the rest of the count with zero bytes. Returns the destination pointer.

name: close_stream_slot_entry
description: Validates a stream slot index against the twenty-entry table and closes the stored handle through a helper unless a flag bit in the slot is set, then clears the slot and returns zero. Invalid indices set error code 3 and return minus one.

name: run_loop_until_helper_done
description: Reads an initial value from a helper, then repeatedly calls a helper pair per iteration until a second helper returns zero, and finishes with fixed cleanup helper calls.

name: accumulate_even_increment_bounded
description: Rounds its argument up to an even number and adds it to a stored accumulator, or calls a helper instead when the sum would exceed a stored limit.

name: draw_marker_at_position
description: Selects a draw position from the state block, either the stored start point or a table entry, and blits a fixed-size region there. When a flag is zero it also plots a small cross-shaped pattern of points around that position.

name: step_marker_toward_target
description: Repeatedly moves a stored position toward a target by at most 30 units per axis, redrawing a clipped region and a small marker pattern at each step until the position equals the target.

name: load_five_record_block
description: Opens a resource through a helper, reads a header of 64 bytes and then five length-prefixed records, invoking an optional callback before and after each record, and closes the resource.

name: call_helper_with_length_32
description: Calls a helper with a stored pointer, its argument and a length of 32.

name: copy_record_field_to_state
description: Copies a longword from a fixed field of a record into a state field.

name: set_flags_from_status_bits
description: Sets two state flags to one, clears the first when bits 192 of a global status word are all set, and clears the second and stores 52225 in the status word when bits 17408 are all set.

name: draw_characters_as_glyphs
description: Draws each character of a zero-terminated string as four rectangular glyph segments, computing each glyph offset from the character code and adding 8 for codes above the letter z.

name: initialize_display_layout_values
description: Stores fixed layout values for two rectangles and their offsets, copies a stored value into several state fields, and calls a helper with 1440.

name: select_slot_values_by_mask
description: Fills five consecutive longword slots in the state block, each taking one of two stored values according to the matching bit of the argument.

name: call_helper_repeatedly
description: Calls a helper with no arguments once for each iteration up to the given count.

name: call_handle_helper_with_arg
description: Calls a library routine with the stored handle and the argument it receives.

name: call_second_handle_helper_arg
description: Calls a different library routine with the stored handle and the argument it receives.

name: call_handle_helper_four_args
description: Calls a library routine with the stored handle and four arguments supplied by the caller.

name: forward_three_args_with_handle
description: Passes its three arguments to the four-argument handle routine, adding the stored handle as the fourth argument.

name: initialize_buffers_and_layout
description: Initializes timing and layout fields, calls a helper with block sizes 9200, 6100, 5900, 4440 and 12800, sets five offsets from a stored value, and when a flag is set initialises four further offsets spaced 8000 apart.

name: initialize_and_save_records
description: Initializes a table of twelve 16-byte entries from a stored base and writes it to the named file opened in old-file mode 1005, then closes the file. It also sets five offsets from stored values.

name: save_two_block_file
description: Opens the named file in old-file mode 1005, writes 45768 bytes from a stored address, seeks to position 21760, writes a further 19292 bytes from the next block and closes the file. A failed open calls an error helper.

name: set_global_status_fifteen
description: Stores 15 in a global status variable.

name: fade_palette_components_down
description: Copies 32 color words into a working palette, then fifteen times lowers each 4-bit red, green and blue component of every color by one step, sending the palette to a helper after each step.

name: fade_palette_toward_target
description: Clears a 32-word working palette, then fifteen times moves each 4-bit red, green and blue component one step toward the matching component of the target palette, sending the working palette to a helper after each step.

name: apply_operand_sign_fixup
description: Calls an arithmetic helper and negates its result when exactly one of the two operand signs held in the data registers is negative.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string, excluding the terminator, and returns the count.

name: multiply_longwords_partial
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values held in the data registers using 16-bit partial products and returns the low 32 bits of the product.

name: run_program_entry_and_cleanup
description: Program entry point: runs a message loop that opens and manages the program's window through library calls, then closes the windows and libraries it opened and returns zero. It refers to dos.library, graphics.library and intuition.library.

name: report_dos_open_failure
description: Stores the dos.library failure message pointer and calls the library routine at vector offset minus 348 to display it.

name: report_graphics_open_failure
description: Stores the graphics.library failure message pointer and calls the library routine at vector offset minus 348 to display it.

name: report_window_open_failure
description: Stores the window failure message pointer and calls the library routine at vector offset minus 348 to display it.

name: show_requester_with_handler
description: Saves the caller's pointer in a handler slot and calls the library routine at vector offset minus 348, which shows a requester through the intuition library.

name: show_68020_install_prompt
description: Stores the install prompt message pointer and calls the library routine at vector offset minus 348 to ask whether the 68020 version should be installed.

name: fetch_workbench_startup_message
description: If the program was started from Workbench rather than a command line, waits on the process port, retrieves the startup message and keeps it for a later reply. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: open_window_after_setup
description: Calls a setup helper and, on success, opens a window through the library routine at vector offset minus 204, stores the window and its related pointer and returns zero. It returns minus one when setup or opening fails.

name: call_library_pair_72_66
description: Stores the result of the library routine at vector offset minus 72 and then calls the routine at vector offset minus 66 on the same library base.

name: call_three_intuition_routines
description: Calls three library routines in sequence on the same base, at vector offsets minus 438, minus 432 and minus 462, and returns nothing.

name: call_two_intuition_routines
description: Calls two library routines in sequence on the same base, at vector offsets minus 438 and minus 432, and returns nothing.

name: call_intuition_routine_444
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 444 and returns nothing.

name: call_intuition_routine_444
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 444 and returns nothing.

name: draw_border_twice
description: Calls the library routine at vector offset minus 108 twice on the same base, which draws a border through the intuition library, and returns nothing.

name: open_workbench_and_layout
description: Opens the Workbench screen through the library routine at vector offset minus 210 and, when that succeeds, stores its pointers, calls a routine at offset minus 474 and computes layout values from a stored count. It returns zero on success and minus one on failure.

name: layout_gadget_rectangles
description: Computes position and size fields for a set of gadget rectangles from window metrics, using one layout for state value 1 and another for state value 4, and returns minus one for any other state. It fills the rectangle fields that the drawing routines read.

name: layout_wide_gadget_rectangles
description: Computes gadget rectangle fields from window metrics with a wider row step than its neighbour, using one layout for state value 1 and another for state value 4, and returns minus one for any other state.

name: layout_gadget_from_argument
description: Fills the gadget rectangle fields of the structure passed in the address register from window metrics, using one layout for state value 1 and another for state value 4, and returns minus one for any other state.

name: redraw_window_gadgets
description: Calls library routines at vector offsets minus 342, minus 348 and minus 354 with the window pointer taken from the argument, then calls the routine at offset minus 306 with no arguments.

name: redraw_stored_window_gadgets
description: Calls the library routines at vector offsets minus 342, minus 348 and minus 354 with a stored window pointer, then calls the routine at offset minus 306 with no arguments.

name: run_installer_event_loop
description: Runs the installer's message loop: it waits on the window port, replies to each message and dispatches gadget selections. Gadget item 1 starts the install actions, items 2, 4 and 5 call a routine at vector offset minus 462, and the loop returns on a close-window message or when gadget item 3 is selected.

name: check_and_trim_path_name
description: Checks a name with a helper, trims the character at the position found in the name, checks it again and restores it. Returns zero on success and minus one when either check fails.

name: normalize_directory_path_name
description: Appends a colon or slash separator to a device or directory name when one is missing, creates the directory through helpers and returns a pointer to the resulting name, or to an empty string when creation fails.

name: write_install_batch_file
description: Writes the install batch file line by line through helpers, comparing each returned value with the expected count and finishing with a closing step. Returns a pointer to the file name, or an empty string on failure.

name: print_intuition_text_message
description: Stores the text structure passed in the address register and calls the intuition library's text printing routine at vector offset minus 216 to draw it.

name: copy_string_address_registers
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the source address register to the destination address register, including the terminator.

name: count_string_characters
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string in the address register, excluding the terminator, and returns the count.

name: call_library2_vector_minus_54
description: Calls the library function at vector offset minus 54 of the second library base stored in the state block, returning nothing.

name: find_char_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for a fixed character and returns its index, or minus one when the character is absent.

name: copy_files_with_info_icons
description: Walks the names of a directory listing, appends each name to a path and runs a copy step through helpers. It opens new files in mode 1006 and checks their size against 824 bytes and skips the icon companion when a name ends in the info suffix, returning minus one on errors.

name: run_install_steps
description: Runs a sequence of installation steps through helper calls, repeating the sequence while the helpers report success. It returns the status of the last step attempted.

name: increment_progress_counter_then_call
description: Increments a counter in the state block and calls a helper, returning the data register pair unchanged.

name: update_progress_value_and_call
description: Increments a second counter when a flag byte is set, stores the stored total divided by 2048, with a minimum of 1, as a progress value, then calls a helper.

name: call_helper_pass_through
description: Calls a helper and returns the data register pair unchanged.

name: call_helper_pass_through
description: Calls a helper and returns the data register pair unchanged.

name: call_helper_pass_through
description: Calls a helper and returns the data register pair unchanged.

name: call_helper_pass_through
description: Calls a helper and returns the data register pair unchanged.

name: draw_progress_bar_fill
description: Computes the filled width of a progress bar as a fraction of its range, clamped to the bar's extent, draws the filled rectangle through the library routine at vector offset minus 342 and then refreshes the window with the routines at offsets minus 348, minus 354 and minus 306.

name: check_abort_request_messages
description: Drains pending window messages, and when a close-window message arrives or gadget item 6 is selected, asks the user to confirm breaking the installation and returns a non-null value when the answer is yes.

name: clear_and_print_status_text
description: Fills a 32-byte status buffer with spaces, then calls a helper and displays the buffer through the intuition text printing routine at vector offset minus 216.

name: allocate_work_buffer_or_fail
description: Allocates a memory buffer through the exec library and returns zero on success, or a pointer to a not-enough-memory message when allocation fails.

name: free_work_buffer
description: Releases the work buffer through the exec library when one is held, clears its pointer and returns zero.

name: free_second_work_buffer
description: Releases the second work buffer through the exec library when one is held, clears its pointer and related counters, and returns zero.

name: reset_install_counters
description: Sets three state variables to zero and returns nothing.
